Subject: Request: technical deep-dive / system integration session

Hi Rishi —

Really enjoyed the product walkthrough last week. The engineering team at VoltOne would like a technical deep-dive so we can validate the integration surface and sizing for our proof-of-concept (data volumes, token estimates, KV cache behavior). Proposed goals:

- Walk through the end-to-end request flow for our ingestion pipeline
- Confirm expected latency and batching behavior under our workload
- Surface any networking/KMS requirements for Private deployments

We were hoping to schedule a 60–75 minute session next week with our data infra lead (Samir) and 2 folks from Redwood (platform + product). Suggested slots (US Pacific):
- Tue 13 Apr 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu 15 Apr 13:00–14:15 PT

Also: can you share a short set of pre-reads (system overview, network diagram, expected token calc examples)? That will help Samir prepare.

Thanks —
Alex
